targets.query:
data =
  from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "${meas}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "error_code_curr")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["pallet_position"] == "L")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["storehouse_id"] == "${rack_id}")
    |> group()
    |> last()
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

error_code =
    data
        |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
        |> rename(columns: {_value: "ErrorCode"})
error_code

data =
    from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(
            start: v.timeRangeStart,
            stop: v.timeRangeStop
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["_measurement"] == "${meas}" and
            (
                r["_field"] == "voltage" or
                r["_field"] == "temperature"
            )
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["storehouse_id"] == "${rack_id}"
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["pallet_position"] == "L"
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["position_id"] == "1"
        )


voltage =
    data
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["_field"] == "voltage"
        )
        |> group()
        |> sort(
            columns: ["_time"],
            desc: true
        )
        |> limit(n: 1)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            _time: r._time,
            _field: "Voltage",
            _value: r._value
        }))


temperature =
    data
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["_field"] == "temperature"
        )
        |> group()
        |> sort(
            columns: ["_time"],
            desc: true
        )
        |> limit(n: 1)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            _time: r._time,
            _field: "Temperature",
            _value: r._value
        }))


union(tables: [

])

list.query: StoreHouseMeasData

list.label: Measurement
list.name: meas
list.query: meas_data

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(m.SerialBoardID AS nvarchar(100)) AS __text,
    CAST(m.SerialBoardID AS nvarchar(100)) AS __value
FROM [BALPS].[dbo].[MeasSessionIndex] AS m
WHERE m.SerialBoardID IS NOT NULL
  AND m.StoreHouseID = CAST(${rack_id:sqlstring} AS int)
  AND m.StartTime >= DATEADD(HOUR, 0, $__timeFrom())
  AND m.StartTime <= DATEADD(HOUR, 0, $__timeTo())
ORDER BY __text;
list.label: Serialboard_ID
list.name: sb_id
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(m.SerialBoardID AS nvarchar(100)) AS __text,
    CAST(m.SerialBoardID AS nvarchar(100)) AS __value
FROM [BALPS].[dbo].[MeasSessionIndex] AS m
WHERE m.SerialBoardID IS NOT NULL
  AND m.StoreHouseID = CAST(${rack_id:sqlstring} AS int)
  AND m.StartTime >= DATEADD(HOUR, 0, $__timeFrom())
  AND m.StartTime <= DATEADD(HOUR, 0, $__timeTo())
ORDER BY __text;

list.definition:
SELECT TOP (1)
    m.SerialBoardID
FROM [BALPS].[dbo].[MeasSessionIndex] AS m
WHERE m.StoreHouseID = CAST(${rack_id:sqlstring} AS int)
  AND m.PalletPosition = 'L'
  AND m.SerialBoardID IS NOT NULL
  AND m.StartTime >= DATEADD(HOUR, 0, $__timeFrom())
  AND m.StartTime <= DATEADD(HOUR, 0, $__timeTo())
ORDER BY
    m.StartTime DESC,
    m.CreatedAt DESC,
    m.SessionIndexID DESC;

list.definition:
SELECT TOP (1)
    m.PalletID AS PalletID
FROM [BALPS].[dbo].[MeasSessionIndex] AS m
WHERE m.StoreHouseID = CAST(${rack_id:sqlstring} AS int)
  AND m.PalletPosition = 'L'
  AND m.QRCode IS NOT NULL
  AND m.StartTime >= DATEADD(HOUR, 0, $__timeFrom())
  AND m.StartTime <= DATEADD(HOUR, 0, $__timeTo())
ORDER BY
    m.StartTime DESC,
    m.CreatedAt DESC,
    m.SessionIndexID DESC;

list.definition:
WITH Latest AS (
    SELECT
        m.QRCode,
        m.StoreHouseID,
        m.PalletPosition,
        m.PositionID,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                m.StoreHouseID,
                m.PalletPosition,
                m.PositionID
            ORDER BY
                m.CreatedAt DESC,
                m.SessionIndexID DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM [BALPS].[dbo].[MeasSessionIndex] AS m
    WHERE m.StoreHouseID = CAST(${rack_id:sqlstring} AS int)
      AND m.PalletPosition = 'L'
      AND m.PositionID = 1
      AND m.QRCode IS NOT NULL
      AND m.StartTime >= DATEADD(HOUR, 0, $__timeFrom())
      AND m.StartTime <= DATEADD(HOUR, 0, $__timeTo())
)
SELECT
    QRCode AS __text,
    QRCode AS __value
FROM Latest
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY PalletPosition;
